expect_stderr_contains: BLOCKED (git discipline): blanket staging via git add -A / --all / . is not allowed.
_why: PE-14 (round-4). git_policy.blanket_staging_message contains a backtick-quoted `git status`. In git-discipline-guard.ps1 that text sits inside an @"..."@ (double-quoted) here-string, where backticks are still PowerShell escape leaders; `` `g `` is not a recognised escape sequence, so PS strips the backtick at PARSE time and the MASTER's own stderr loses it -- a master defect, confirmed by U-0. The port prints the message text correctly (backticks intact), so full-stderr equality with the master fails on every blanket_staging BLOCK case even though the port is right.
